expected.control_accounting: Exact-source APDU checking; Lean 4.33.1 MutualDef.elabMutualDef processes examples under withoutModifyingEnv. No persisted example names assumed.

host_tcb: Ubuntu 24.04 runner, Python stdlib and system loader/libraries are trusted separately; no reuse of local host-library hashes.
physical_guard_scope: Sampled host available-memory and disk floors, direct Lean RSS and bounded fresh-tree logical/allocated size. Not continuous process-tree containment.
process_scope: Fresh owned session/process group; direct child reaped after bounded pipe capture. No arbitrary escaped-descendant emptiness proof.
signature_scope: Exact locked source statements and examples; owner/name/kind audit is not independent restatement.
source_update_policy: No runtime update mode. Any changed source/driver/consumer/support/distribution requires a reviewed contract revision and matching CONTRACT_SHA256 change in check.py; outer publication manifest binds check.py.
